usage.callShape: POST https://www.getquali.com/api/v1/polls with JSON body {question, options:[{text}], maxResponses, expiresAt} (description/mediaUrl/layoutType/callbackUrl optional)

inputExample.question: QA test poll by John Doe (john.doe@gmail.com) - do you like USDC micropayments?
inputExample.description: Registry QA verification poll created via x402. Contact: John Doe, john.doe@gmail.com.

usage.outputShape: body.id (uuid), body.url (public poll page), body.readToken (use to read private results), body.endpoints.poll / body.endpoints.results / body.endpoints.votes (API URLs), body.pricing.costUsdc, body.payment.txHash
quirks: Price is VARIABLE: $0.005 USDC per response. Quote = rewardPool (maxResponses * 0.005) + Quali fee. With minimum maxResponses=100 the quote was $0.50 (pool $0.05 + fee $0.45). Higher maxResponses = higher charge; cap your maxResponses to control cost.
Required fields: question, options (2-10 items, each {text}), maxResponses (integer >=100, max 1000000), expiresAt (ISO8601, must be at least 5 minutes in the future).
OUTWARD: creates a REAL public poll page at body.url that anyone can vote on. This is an irreversible publish action.
Save body.readToken from the 201 response - it is needed to read results from the results endpoint later (not re-fetchable).
Returns 201 (not 200) on success. Payment txHash is inside body.payment.txHash; qa-pay reported txHash:null but the on-chain hash is in the response body.
usage.guide: POST a JSON body to https://www.getquali.com/api/v1/polls with question, options array of {text} (2-10), maxResponses (>=100), and a future ISO8601 expiresAt; pays x402 USDC on Base, no API key. Price is variable at $0.005/response so keep maxResponses low. On 201 success you get body.id, public body.url, and body.readToken. Save the readToken and body.endpoints.results to fetch responses later. Publishes a real public poll, so confirm before calling.
